contentText: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have advanced to within about 60 kilometers of the seat of Yemen’s internationally recognized government in the southern city of Aden, but the forces fighting them have set up a fortified line to defend the city, a military official said Tuesday. The Houthis' advance toward Aden has come after forces allied with the government withdrew from areas on the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, allowing the Houthis to consolidate their grip on territory around the crucial waterway.
